aid.title: Swarthmore — Financial Aid for International Students

test_policy.notes: SAT/ACT optional for the 2026-27 cycle; applicants can also choose to suppress scores already sent. SAT is superscored, ACT is not; SAT/ACT writing sections are not considered. Self-reported scores accepted; enrolling students must send official scores (if they took a test).

requirements.notes: Two Swarthmore short answers (max 250 words each) on the Common App / Coalition application. Interviews are offered and optional (no disadvantage if skipped); the page does not say whether they are evaluative. Applicants whose schooling is outside the U.S. must submit one of: Swarthmore Video Response, an English proficiency exam, or an InitialView/Vericant video. CSS Profile is required only from international students who apply for aid, after admission (fee waived).

deadlines.label: Early Decision I
deadlines.notes: Decisions released online in mid-December (no exact date published). Requires the ED agreement and first-quarter senior grades.

deadlines.label: Early Decision II
deadlines.notes: Decisions released online in mid-February (no exact date published).

english_policy.waiver_notes: Applicants attending school outside the U.S. must submit ONE of: Video Response, an English proficiency exam (TOEFL, IELTS or Duolingo), or an InitialView/Vericant video. Testing is 'encouraged' if most of your education was in a non-English-language curriculum. Only the highest score from a single sitting is considered (no mixing of sittings). Duolingo results must be sent officially via Duolingo.

aid.notes: Admission is need-aware for international citizens. Admitted international students who applied for aid get 100% of demonstrated need (up to full tuition, with a $800 book allowance), as grants with no loans. Aid must be requested on the admission application. CSS Profile (code 2821) and the ISAFA form are due within 7 days of the admission decision. International students in the Class of 2030 and later get a four-year aid decision.

duolingo.note: No numeric code; results must be sent officially to Swarthmore through your Duolingo account.
